intent: Passive reporting of where we stand and what the organiser Bias Scorecard says about our scored submissions. The row and the operator amendment of 2026-10-24 both forbid uploads and any scorecard- or leaderboard-driven feature, threshold or parameter change; this file exists so the snapshot's scope cannot drift.
metric: public RMSE on the 30% public split; the organiser Bias Scorecard reports per-dimension disparity ratios alongside it

dropped_submission_fields.url: presigned S3 download URL embedding an AWS access-key id and a request signature; never committed

excluded_submission_ids.ggVY44Ui: status=failed with 'Missing entries for IDs 53001950100, ...'; its 0.0 placeholder is not a score and the ledger records public_score=null

measure_before: no leaderboard snapshot existed in the repo and no scorecard file had ever been stored; our best public score was 0.091440198 (P4, submission ySXi73rd) with no recorded rank, team count, top-20 table or organiser scorecard

negative_controls.note: a presigned-URL-shaped string injected into a committed scorecard must be caught by the secret scan
an auth-token-shaped string injected into the leaderboard snapshot must be caught
a scorecard missing a required field must fail the completeness gate
a snapshot without its UTC stamp must fail, because the row requires dated snapshot files

acceptance: reports/leaderboard/<UTC>.json committed with the top-20 public RMSE table, our rank and the team count
reports/scorecards/<submission_id>.json committed for every successful submission, including C0 and P4
gap between our best and the top-10 boundary recorded and reproducible to 1e-12
no secrets, cookies or tokens anywhere in the committed outputs
no upload performed and no scorecard- or leaderboard-driven model change
Scorecard reflection paragraph present in docs/writeup/methodology.md
pin_reason: the committed snapshot is a dated record; pinning the ledger event keeps --check-only and the reproduce command byte-stable while the steward keeps appending newer snapshots to the shared ledger
